messages: marisol: Quick a11y flag in Insights -> Model Metrics. Legend keys (series labels) are clickable with mouse to toggle series but are not keyboard-focusable. SRs also don't announce whether a series is hidden or visible. Anyone else seen this? oj: I can reproduce. Tab skips legend entirely. This is the time-series line chart on the Model Metrics page. nora-ux: Oof. We intended legend to be interactive. Best practice is either role=\"button\" with aria-pressed or role=\"checkbox\" for each legend item so state is exposed. Also the visual dim for hidden series is only opacity on the stroke; marker contrast drops below accessible thresholds. sam_k: Implementation note: our chart lib renders legend in SVG groups which aren't tabbable. Two approaches: 1) render a DOM overlay for the legend (ul/li/button) synced with the SVG; 2) add focusable + with tabindex and aria-pressed (harder). I prefer DOM legend synced via the chart render hooks. access-bot: a11y-scan: HIGH: interactive legend not keyboard reachable; MEDIUM: missing aria-pressed/aria-checked; LOW: color contrast of disabled stroke/marker < 3:1. Recommend DOM controls + aria-live confirmation. marisol: Proposed markup (sketch): ``` <ul class=\"chart-legend\" aria-label=\"Model metrics series legend\"> <li> <button class=\"chart-legend-item\" aria-pressed=\"false\" data-series=\"latency\">Latency <span class=\"visually-hidden\">Toggle series: Latency</span></button> </li> </ul> <div aria-live=\"polite\" class=\"chart-legend-status sr-only\" id=\"legend-status\">Series Latency visible</div> ``` This gives a single focus stop per legend item, announces toggle state, and is keyboard operable (Enter/Space). nora-ux: Yes. Also ensure when a user toggles via keyboard, focus stays on the legend item (don't move to canvas). And update canvas `aria-describedby` to reference #legend-status so SR users know current state. oj: I'll spike this afternoon: convert current legend renderer to output an accessible <ul> and emit events for the chart to hide/show series. I'll add keyboard handlers for Enter/Space and ensure focus styling. sam_k: Frontend note: add E2E keyboard test that tabs into legend, toggles a series, and asserts that the aria-live region contains \"hidden\"/\"visible\" accordingly. Also update telemetry to track keyboard toggles (for usage + regressions). marisol: UX question: focus style — propose using focus token `--focus-ring-legend: 3px solid #ffd66b;` for both light/dark so it stands out against colored series. Thoughts? nora-ux: Works for contrast and feels distinct from primary focus ring. Fine. access-bot: Additional suggestion: for users of assistive tech that rely on semantics, consider role=\"listbox\" + aria-multiselectable=\"true\" if toggling behaves like multi-select. (Either approach okay; document the choice in PR.) marisol: Great. @sam_k @oj please coordinate on PR: keep changes scoped (legend DOM + aria-live + tests). I'll review before merge. Thanks all :rocket:
